name: Little Exhale
subtitle: Breathing room, every day
promotionalText: A small pause, a softer next moment. Follow gentle breathing and relaxation practices with two quiet companions. No account, no streaks, no pressure.
description:
Some days, you just need a little room to breathe.

Little Exhale offers gentle breathing and body practices for ordinary moments: after a busy day, before your next task, or when you want to settle into rest. A small cat and dog keep you company, with movements that follow the practice rather than asking anything of you.

FIND YOUR SMALL PAUSE
Try a two-part sigh, a longer out-breath, even breathing, box breathing, gentle belly breathing, or alternate-nostril breathing. There are also guided meditation, a resting body scan (NSDR), pelvic floor practice, and progressive muscle relaxation. Each practice explains what to do and lets you choose an available duration.

FOLLOW AT YOUR OWN PACE
Hear warm English guidance or choose sound cues or silence. Skip the introduction when you know the practice. Pause, continue, or finish whenever you need to. Visual guidance follows the actual inhale, exhale, hold, or release. Natural-breathing practices leave your breathing rhythm to you.

A GENTLER LOOK AT YOUR DAY
Keep an optional feeling note, record drinks, revisit your practice history, and find small acts of care. If you choose to connect Apple Health, sleep and body measurements can provide additional context. The optional daily index is a wellness estimate, not a medical assessment.

LESS TO MANAGE
No account to create. No streak to protect. No ads or subscription. Core records stay on your device, and bundled practice audio works offline. Appearance, text size, sound, haptic, and motion preferences help you make the space your own.

Little Exhale was previously called Fangcun. Updating keeps your existing local records and preferences.

These practices support general wellbeing and do not diagnose or treat medical conditions. Follow the in-app guidance, keep movements gentle, and stop if something feels uncomfortable.
whatsNew:
Fangcun is now Little Exhale.

• A thoughtfully rewritten English experience, with warm spoken guidance.
• New cat and dog movements that follow each practice without stretching their faces or bodies.
• A quieter Daily page for feelings, drinks, small acts of care, and optional Apple Health context.
• Ten practices, including progressive muscle relaxation, with skippable introductions and adjustable sound.

Your existing practice settings, local records, and preferences stay with you.
reviewNotes:
This is an update to the existing Fangcun app, now branded Little Exhale. The bundle identifier and local data model are retained. No account or login is required.

The Breathe tab contains ten practices. Tap Begin for the default five-minute sigh, or select another practice and duration. Introductions can be skipped. Pause/end controls remain available throughout. The Daily tab contains optional check-ins, drink logging, records, settings, and an expandable Body context section. Apple Health authorization is optional; all practices work without it.

The app offers general wellbeing guidance, not medical diagnosis or treatment. The daily index is an optional wellness estimate. The app has no in-app purchases, advertising, or account registration.

Audio is bundled for offline use. Background audio is used only during an active practice with continuous audio enabled. Please review with sound on to hear the English guide.
